comments.body_html: If you use notepad++ or VSCodium you can reenable them but I disabled some for simplification. And Balance is subjective. Unfortunately I cant speak for what individual opinions are but I can guide you to creating your own modifications to the JSON with the resources available here on the hub!

comments.author: Moloch
comments.body_html: Buff to armor damage, Nerf to penetration in a lot of cases. Most are intermediate and PDW cartridges so their pen or damage was nerfed to compensate.

comments.author: Moloch
comments.body_html:
I cant give a comprehensive list at the moment due to other projects ongoing. But the 4 Categories touched are Damage, Penetration, Armor damage, and if its tracer or not.

I took away all the tracer effects from rounds that shouldnt have it, Disabled some I couldn’t find enough information on and the explosive ammunitions since they bypass armor completely.

For damage Some was raised some was lowered depending on pistol, intermediate, pdw, rifle, etc. Penetration was done to give a more usable progression of ammunition and wider use case for some. And all armor damage was brought in line to BSG values so even if the penetration was lowered it will still go through the armor quite effectively.
